description: Given explicit excluded middle, the existing borrowing-cut principle applied to this recorded actual-concrete grounding graph is equivalent to well-founded actual concrete grounding. Cut-to-WF applies the cut to the set of inaccessible nodes; WF-to-cut chooses a minimal member of each nonempty set and distinguishes whether it is a source or has a nonempty supplier outside that set. This identifies shared premise strength, not independent philosophical confirmation or a weaker foundation assumption.
